battle.name: 宋平劉義宣之戰
battle.theater: 長江梁山洲、姑孰至江陵水道
battle.brief: 孝建元年，鎮江陵的荊州刺史劉義宣舉兵東下，兵鋒直指建康。梁山洲一戰，叛軍舟師被王玄謨與垣護之攻破焚毀，義宣逃回江陵，六月庚寅為新任荊州刺史朱脩之所誅。卡面所配埃及月牙劍早於此役近兩千年且從未東傳，此役真正上手的是環首刀、長槍、弩弓與乘風放火焚船的火攻。

kit.name: 埃及月牙劍
kit.history: 外彎的單刃劍，砍下去不用拔。它比直劍更早出現在埃及人的手上。

countries: 此役的交戰雙方，是劉宋朝廷與以荊州為根據地的宗室劉義宣。朝廷一方以孝武帝劉駿總攬軍政：起義爆發後，孝武帝以宗室重臣參贊機務，命雍州刺史朱脩之改鎮荊州，接手上游防務；王玄謨領兵北至梁山洲，與叛軍水軍正面相持；柳元景進屯姑孰，總統諸軍，掌握建康至荊州之間的江防樞紐，攔截東下的船隊與糧船。叛軍一方以劉義宣本人為核心：他被授予都督荊湘雍梁寧南北秦八州諸軍事、荊湘二州刺史的職名，節制荊州與湘州一帶的州郡和軍鎮，以參軍劉諶之為腹心，命八子劉慆留鎮江陵，另遣魯秀率兵討伐拒不支持他的雍州刺史朱脩之，又聯絡豫州刺史魯爽、兗州刺史徐遺寶同時舉兵。江州刺史臧質是叛軍的實際策劃者與水軍統帥，與義宣會師尋陽後一同東下。荊州是南朝上游的重鎮，《宋書》稱其「地廣兵強，資實兵甲，居朝廷之半」，義宣據此經營十年，兵資、糧秣與船艦都出自荊湘；朝廷一方則握有建康、揚州、豫州、司州的中央兵力與漕運線。魯爽在豫州擅自稱帝、造出輿服與版文，把整場陰謀提前暴露，使原定秋季才發動的舉兵被迫倉促進行。
countriesEn: The two parties in this war were the court of the Liu Song and the Prince of Nanjun, Liu Yixuan, who held Jingzhou as his base. On the court side the war was directed by Emperor Xiaowu, Liu Jun: once the rising broke, the emperor set his kinsmen to assist in the conduct of affairs, ordered the governor of Yongzhou, Zhu Xiuzhi, to take over the defence of the upper river as governor of Jingzhou, and sent Wang Xuanmo north with troops to Liangshan Island, where he was matched face to face by the rebel fleet; Liu Yuanjing advanced to Gushu and took the overall command of the several armies, holding the pivot of the river defence between Jiankang and Jingzhou and cutting off the fleets and grain boats coming down the water. On the rebel side the core was Liu Yixuan himself: he held the titles of Commander of the Armies of the Eight Provinces of Jing, Xiang, Yong, Liang, Ning, Southern Qin and Northern Qin and Governor of Jing and Xiang, and so commanded the prefectures and garrisons of Jingzhou and Xiangzhou; he took Liu Chenzhi, his military adviser, as his confidant, ordered his eighth son Liu Tang to stay behind and hold Jiangling, detached Lu Xiu with troops to punish Zhu Xiuzhi, the governor of Yongzhou who refused to support him, and arranged for the governor of Yu province, Lu Shuang, and the governor of Yan province, Xu Yibao, to rise at the same time. Zang Zhi, governor of Jiangzhou, was the real planner of the rising and the commander of its war fleet; after joining Yixuan at Xunyang the two moved east together. Jingzhou was the great stronghold of the upper river in the Southern Dynasties, and the History of Song says of it that it was broad in extent, strong in troops, rich in stores of weapons and armour, and held half the troops of the court; Yixuan had worked on it for ten years, and the men, the money, the grain and the shipping all came from Jing and Xiang. The court, for its part, held the central troops of Jiankang, Yangzhou, Yu province and Si province together with the grain route. Lu Shuang's getting drunk in Yu province, raising troops on his own, forging the ceremonial robes and issuing the edict that styled Yixuan emperor, brought the whole plot into the open, and a rising that had been set for the autumn was forced forward into a hurried start in the spring.
people: 劉義宣是宋武帝劉裕第六子，母為孫美人，幼年封竟陵王，成年後歷任荊州刺史、司空、司徒。他因在荊州經營兵眾十年，又在元嘉三十年劉劭弒父之亂中起兵討賊，聲名與實力都到了一時無兩的地步，卻天性闇懦、言語不便，遇事多謀而無斷。參軍劉諶之是他唯一倚重的謀臣；臧質在江州屢次密書勸他舉兵，又提出以萬人取南州、令梁山中絕，再以萬人綴住王玄謨，自率水軍循外江直取石頭的兩路夾擊之策。劉諶之則力主盡攻梁山洲，並引江夏王劉駿「昔桓玄借兵於仲堪，有似今日」的書信提醒義宣提防臧質，義宣遂不從臧質之計。官軍主將王玄謨屯兵梁山洲，以西壘、東壘兩處水寨相持；叛軍部將垣護之在五月二十一日的決戰中乘風放火，燒毀自家船隊，也把西岸的義宣一起卷入火勢。梁山上潰敗之後，義宣乘數百舸西走，到江夏聞巴陵有敵軍，改由逕口步行逃回江陵，部眾散盡，隨從只剩十餘人，因腳痛向沿路居民借車求食。江陵尚餘一萬多名士兵，領兵迎接的竺超民與魯秀想再集合餘眾決戰，義宣卻已迷惘昏亂、不肯出見，殘眾自行散去，魯秀北逃。義宣最後與八子劉慆及五名易為男裝的愛妾準備出城，中途遇亂墮馬，改步行出城，兵散後折返南郡官舍，因沒有牀而席地坐到天亮，隨後被押入獄戶處；六月庚寅，新任荊州刺史朱脩之抵達江陵，未待劉義恭與八座下書，便將義宣、其諸子與同黨盡數誅殺，義宣時年四十。
peopleEn: Liu Yixuan was the sixth son of Emperor Wu of Song, Liu Yu, born of the Lady Sun. He was enfeoffed as Prince of Jingling as a child and in later years served as governor of Jingzhou, as sikong and as situ. After ten years of building up a following in Jingzhou, and after raising troops against Liu Shao's parricide in the thirtieth year of Yuanjia, his fame and his armed strength stood without a rival, yet he was dull in character and slow of speech, full of plans that came to nothing. Liu Chenzhi, his military adviser, was the one man on whom he truly relied. Zang Zhi, governor of Jiangzhou, wrote to him again and again to urge a rising, and proposed the plan of taking Nan province with ten thousand men so that Liangshan would be cut off, and ten thousand more to pin down Wang Xuanmo, while he himself led the water forces by the outer channel straight against Shitou. Liu Chenzhi argued instead for putting everything into the attack on Liangshan Island, and quoted the letter of the Prince of Jiangxia, Liu Jun, that in former days Xuan Huan had borrowed troops from Zhong Kan, which was much the same as this, to warn Yixuan to be on his guard against Zang Zhi; Yixuan accordingly did not take Zang Zhi's plan. The court's commander Wang Xuanmo was posted at Liangshan Island, where he was matched against the rebels at two water stockades, the western and the eastern. On the twenty-first day of the fifth month, in the decisive action, the rebel commander Yuan Huzhi took advantage of the wind and set fire to the ships, and the flames that consumed the fleet also caught Yixuan on the west bank. After the rout on Liangshan, Yixuan fled west with several hundred barges; learning at Jiangxia that enemy troops were at Baling, he changed to walking at Jingkou and made his way back to Jiangling, and the multitude scattered, leaving him with a dozen followers. His feet pained him so that he had to take a cart from the people of the road and ask the households along the way for food. More than ten thousand men were still in Jiangling, and Zhu Chaomin, who came out to meet him, and Lu Xiu wanted to gather the remnants and fight again, but Yixuan was already confused and dazed and would not show himself to the soldiers; the survivors went off of their own accord and Lu Xiu fled north. Yixuan at last made ready his weapons and his food and water to leave with his eighth son Liu Tang and five concubines dressed as men, but the confusion of armed men in the city frightened him so that he fell from his horse and had to go out on foot. When the troops dispersed near the city he turned back at night and sat on the ground through the dawn in the empty residence of the Prince of Nanjun, for there was no bed. He was then put in the prison quarter, and on the gengyin day of the sixth month the new governor of Jingzhou, Zhu Xiuzhi, reached Jiangling and put Yixuan, his sons and his party to the sword without waiting for the letter written by the Grand Marshal Liu Yigong and the Eight Excellencies ordering his death. Yixuan was forty years old.
kits: 卡面這件埃及月牙劍，是前一千五百年上下埃及人所用的外彎單刃短劍，刃形由更早的斧形刃演變而來，靠刃身外彎所成的重量與弧線劈砍，砍下去不必拔起。它的作用是砍而不是刺，適合對付缺乏重甲的目標，遇到鐵甲、盾面與弩箭都不占便宜，到公元前一千年上下便基本被直刃劍取代，公元五世紀只餘史冊與收藏中的古物，從未傳入中國，此役的戰場上自然沒有它；外形最接近的倒是中國商周出土的弧背曲刃青銅戈與鉞，但兩者並無任何流傳上的關係。劉宋一方真正上手的近戰兵器是環首刀與直刃劍，槍矛是步卒結陣的主幹，弓與弩供遠程壓制，人馬皆著札甲、鐵甲的披甲兵與兜鍪是攻守的骨幹；水師配蒙衝、鬥艦與走馬樓一類船隻，舟上備盾、拒馬與火炬，糧秣靠運兵船與糧船自荊湘順流而下，魯爽在豫州一度造出輿服、黃標與法服，那卻是儀仗與造反的道具，不是作戰的裝備。此役最要緊的一次器械運用是火：垣護之在梁山洲乘風放火，燒毀臧質的船隊，火借風勢順著水面竄向密集的舟艦，一次攻勢頓時化為火海；同一種火也在兵營與村落用來照明、燒飯與焚毀阻礙，火箭與火矢則用來射擊船上的敵人。
kitsEn: The Egyptian khopesh on this card is the short, outward-curved single-edged blade used in Egypt about fifteen hundred years before the present; its shape developed out of the earlier axe-like blade, and it cuts by the weight and the curve of the blade rather than by any thrusting motion, so that it need not be pulled back after a blow. Its business was cutting rather than stabbing, which suited it against unarmoured targets, while against iron armour, a shield face or a crossbow bolt it was at a disadvantage; by about a thousand years before the present it had been displaced by the straight sword, and in the fifth century it survived only in the records and in collections, never having reached China, so it naturally had no part in this battle. The nearest thing to it in shape is the curved-bladed bronze dagger-axe and axe of the Shang and Zhou excavated in China, but the two have no connection in transmission of any kind. What the Liu Song troops actually handled in close fighting were the ring-pommel dao and the straight jian, with the spear and the lance as the backbone of the infantry order of battle, the bow and the crossbow for long-range pressure, and armoured foot and horse in lamellar and iron armour with helmets, which were the backbone of both attack and defence. The fleet had mengchong, doujian and other war boats, with shields, caltrops and torches carried on board, and grain came down the river from Jing and Xiang in troop barges and grain boats; Lu Shuang at one point had forged ceremonial robes, yellow banners and imperial dress in Yu province, but those were the props of a usurpation rather than equipment for fighting. The one piece of equipment that mattered most in this campaign was fire: at Liangshan Island Yuan Huzhi set fire to the ships with the wind behind him, and the flames ran along the water into the packed hulls, turning one assault at once into a sea of fire. The same fire lit barracks and villages, cooked the soldiers' rice and burned the obstacles in the way, while fire-arrows and burning shafts were shot at the enemy crews on the river.
tactics: 這場起義本身是一場準備不足的軍事行動。劉義宣自劉劭之亂平定後便暗中在荊州準備船艦與士卒，原定孝建元年秋季才發動，豫州刺史魯爽卻因酒醉在二月擅自起兵，造出輿服並以版文尊義宣為天子，反把整個陰謀推到光天化日之下，義宣只得倉卒舉兵：先遣參軍劉諶之等出江陵與臧質會合，自率號稱十萬的軍隊於二十一日出發下，與臧質會師尋陽後一同東下，中途得知魯爽死、徐遺寶敗的訊息而軍心浮動。行軍部署上，臧質原定的計畫是兩路大軍同時出手：一路取南州，令梁山洲與王玄謨主力隔絕；一路綴住玄謨；自率水軍循外江直取石頭城，逼近建康。義宣採納劉諶之的對策，專力攻梁山洲，先取西壘再攻東壘。五月十九日臧質乘風猛攻玄謨江邊的西壘得手，五月二十一日義宣率眾到梁山，臧質出戰東壘，玄謨盡出精銳衝入，叛軍陣腳被突破而大潰，垣護之乘風放火焚毀舟船，連西岸的義宣也被火勢所逼，數百舸隨之西走。此後是崩潰而不是抵抗：義宣在江夏聞巴陵有敵軍，改步行逃回江陵，腳痛不能行，借車乞食，跟隨者只剩十餘人；江陵尚存一萬多兵，魯秀與竺超民欲再集餘眾，義宣卻不見將士，眾遂散，魯秀北逃。撤退一旦失去統一號令，兵船、糧秣與部眾同時解體，官軍則沿江節節截斷，殘部很快被掃清。
tacticsEn: The rising was a military operation that had never been properly prepared. Since the defeat of Liu Shao, Yixuan had been quietly building shipping and troops in Jingzhou and had planned to move in the autumn of the first year of Xiaojian, but the governor of Yu province, Lu Shuang, in his cups, raised troops in the second month, forged the imperial robes and issued the edict styling Yixuan emperor, and thrust the whole plot into daylight, so that Yixuan had to rise in a hurry. He first sent Liu Chenzhi and others ahead from Jiangling to join Zang Zhi, and on the twenty-first day marched out himself with a force put at a hundred thousand, joined Zang Zhi at Xunyang, and the two moved east together, losing heart as they learned on the way that Lu Shuang was dead and Xu Yibao defeated. The operational plan Zang Zhi had proposed was to strike with two armies at once: one to seize Nan province and so cut Liangshan Island off from Wang Xuanmo's main force, one to pin Xuanmo down, while he himself took the water forces by the outer channel straight against Shitou and pressed on to Jiankang. Yixuan took Liu Chenzhi's advice instead and put all his strength into Liangshan Island, taking the western stockade first and then the eastern. On the nineteenth day of the fifth month Zang Zhi took advantage of the wind and fell hard on Xuanmo's western stockade on the riverbank and carried it; on the twenty-first Yixuan brought the army to Liangshan and Zang Zhi attacked the eastern stockade, Xuanmo put out all his picked troops, the rebel line was broken and collapsed, and Yuan Huzhi set fire to the shipping with the wind, so that the flames drove Yixuan off the west bank as well, several hundred barges following him west. What followed was collapse rather than resistance: hearing at Jiangxia that there were enemy troops at Baling, Yixuan turned to the road on foot, and with his feet paining him he had to borrow carts and beg food, only a dozen men still following him. In Jiangling more than ten thousand troops remained, and Lu Xiu and Zhu Chaomin wished to gather them again, but Yixuan would not face his men and they dispersed; Lu Xiu fled north. Once the retreat lost a single voice of command, the ships, the grain and the men came apart at the same time, while the court cut the river reach by reach and swept up the remnants.
data: 留下數字的史籍以《宋書·劉義宣傳》《宋書·臧質傳》《資治通鑑》卷一百五十二為主。兵力方面，義宣出師時自稱十萬，是南朝將領慣用的概數，荊州軍的骨幹是步卒與水軍；江陵之亂起時據載尚有一萬多名士兵留在城中；此前劉義宣討劉劭時曾遣參軍徐遺寶率兵三千赴江州助劉駿為前鋒。時間線清晰：劉劭弒父在元嘉三十年，義宣以討賊起兵，劉駿即位後晉封義宣為南郡王、食邑萬戶；孝建元年二月魯爽擅自舉兵暴露全局，義宣於是年二十一日起兵東下，五月十九日臧質乘風破西壘，五月二十一日梁山洲決戰敗，隨後西走江陵，六月庚寅在江陵被誅，換算為西曆是公元四五四年八月四日，義宣死時四十歲。距離與時間上，江陵至建康順流而下需十餘日，叛軍的糧秣全靠楚地米糧沿江輸送，任何一段江防被切斷，遠在荊州的義宣就會先缺糧。荊州一地，《宋書》稱「地廣兵強，資實兵甲，居朝廷之半」，義宣在荊州擔任刺史先後近十年，這就是他敢於東下的全部資本。卡面那件兵器年代更早：埃及月牙劍約成於前一千五百年，至遲在公元前一千年上下已被直刃劍取代，與此役相隔約一千九百年。
dataEn: The figures that survive come mainly from the biography of Liu Yixuan in the History of Song, the biography of Zang Zhi and the hundred and fifty-second volume of the Comprehensive Mirror. On strength, the army was announced as a hundred thousand on the march, the round number that Southern Dynasties commanders used for a great host, and the fighting core of the Jingzhou forces was infantry and boatmen; when the alarm came back to Jiangling, the records say that more than ten thousand men were still in the city; and earlier, when Yixuan moved against Liu Shao, he had sent his military adviser Xu Yibao with three thousand men to the aid of Liu Jun in Jiangzhou as his vanguard. The sequence of dates is clear: Liu Shao killed his father in the thirtieth year of Yuanjia, Yixuan rose to punish the usurper, and after Liu Jun took the throne he was advanced to Prince of Nanjun with a fief of ten thousand households; in the second month of the first year of Xiaojian Lu Shuang's drunken rising exposed the whole affair, so that Yixuan marched out on the twenty-first day of that year, Zang Zhi took the western stockade with the wind on the nineteenth day of the fifth month, the decision at Liangshan Island was lost on the twenty-first, the flight west to Jiangling followed, and on the gengyin day of the sixth month he was killed in Jiangling, which corresponds to the fourth of August, 454, in the Western calendar; he was forty years old. On distance and time, the descent from Jiangling to Jiankang took something over ten days, and the rebels' grain came entirely from the rice of the Chu country carried along the river; cut any stretch of that river defence and Yixuan, far away in Jingzhou, would be the first to go short of food. As for Jingzhou itself, the History of Song calls it broad in extent, strong in troops, rich in weapons and armour, holding half the troops of the court, and Yixuan had held the office of governor there for close on ten years, and that was the whole of the capital on which he had staked his rising. The weapon on the card is far older: the Egyptian khopesh was made about fifteen hundred years before the present and had been displaced by the straight sword by about a thousand years before the present, some nineteen hundred years before this war.
cause: 打起上來有四層原因疊在一起。第一層是地理與制度的死結：荊州居長江中游的上游，《宋書》稱其「地廣兵強，資實兵甲，居朝廷之半」，劉宋立國之初便以諸王分鎮荊州為制，劉義宣做了近十年荊州刺史，把兵資、糧秣與船艦一手置於宗室手中，這在以防宗室為基本國策的朝廷看來始終是隱患。第二層是劉義宣本人的處境：他雖被進封司徒、改任揚州刺史，卻因劉劭之亂未能赴任，仍舊坐鎮江陵；赴任入朝等於交出兵權，留鎮等於自據上游，兩難之下，舉兵成了他自認唯一還能選的路。第三層是人的因素：江州刺史臧質有才而無安分，認定義宣闇懦可制，屢次密書勸反，甚至一度想推他稱帝；孝武帝與義宣諸女的醜事又令義宣羞憤難容。第四層是意外：豫州刺史魯爽嗜酒，在二月便擅自起兵、造出輿服並用版文尊義宣為天子，陰謀提前曝光，原本約定秋季發動的計劃被迫提前到春天倉促進行，而北魏在元嘉末年大舉南下的陰影，也一直壓在荊州人心上。
causeEn: Four causes were stacked one on top of another. The first is a structural deadlock of geography and institutions: Jingzhou lay on the upper reaches of the middle Yangzi, and the History of Song describes it as broad in extent, strong in troops, rich in weapons and armour, holding half the troops of the court. From the founding of Liu Song the princes had been posted to Jingzhou as a matter of policy, and Liu Yixuan had been governor there for close on ten years, holding the men, the money, the grain and the shipping in his own hands; to a court whose basic policy was to guard against the clan, this was a standing danger. The second is Yixuan's own position: though he had been advanced to situ and moved to the governorship of Yangzhou, the affair of Liu Shao had kept him from taking up that post, and he remained in Jiangling; going to the capital meant giving up his troops, staying meant holding the upper river by himself, and in that deadlock a rising was the one road he thought was open to him. The third is people: Zang Zhi, governor of Jiangzhou, was able and restless, judged Yixuan dull enough to be directed, and wrote again and again to urge him to rebel, even entertaining the idea of making him emperor; and the disgraceful business between the emperor and Yixuan's daughters drove the prince to a fury he could not contain. The fourth is accident: the governor of Yu province, Lu Shuang, was a drinker, and in the second month he raised troops on his own, forged the imperial robes and issued the edict naming Yixuan emperor, so that the plot was uncovered and a rising planned for the autumn had to be rushed into the spring, while the shadow of the great southern incursion of the Northern Wei at the end of the Yuanjia years sat heavy on the thoughts of Jingzhou.
impact: 此役的結果不只是平叛，更是劉宋宗室勢力的一次大規模清算。荊州十年間集中於劉義宣掌握的兵眾、武庫與船艦被朝廷收回，荊州刺史由雍州刺史朱脩之接任，這位由前線將領直接接手上游的安排，說明朝廷此後對荊州改為以可靠將領鎮守，不再把上游交給宗室；義宣諸子劉恢、劉善藏、劉愷、劉惔、劉惇等被誅於江寧墓所，參與同黨亦遭清洗，宗室在朝中的份額被大幅削弱，孝武帝對諸王的疑忌由此更重。此役在戰術上的意義同樣不小：梁山洲一役是中國水戰中以風助火、焚燒密集舟艦的早期記載之一，垣護之乘風放火破敵之法，與其後隋唐水師的火箭、蒙衝衝撞同屬一條技術脈絡；反面則是分兵與互疑的教訓，義宣不肯用臧質的兩路夾擊之策，終致兵力不能合用，崩潰時又各自逃散，說明上游宗室軍鎮一旦與中央脫節，失敗會比任何一次正面會戰都快。歷史的評價也留在史書的論斷裡：此役之後，江南的軍鎮與中央的關係再未回到元嘉末年以前的樣子。
impactEn: The result of this war was not merely the suppression of a rising but a general reckoning with the power of the Liu Song clan. The troops, the armoury and the shipping that Liu Yixuan had gathered in Jingzhou over ten years were taken back by the court, and the governorship of Jingzhou passed to Zhu Xiuzhi, the governor of Yongzhou; that a commander straight from the front line was set over the upper river shows that from this time the court put trusted generals in Jingzhou instead of a kinsman. Yixuan's sons, Liu Hui, Liu Shancang, Liu Kai, Liu Tan and Liu Dun among them, were put to death at the burial place at Jiangning, and his party was purged, the clan's share in the court was cut back sharply, and the emperor's suspicion of the princes grew heavier. The tactical meaning of the campaign is no smaller: the action at Liangshan Island is one of the earliest Chinese records of fire being used with the wind to burn crowded ships, and the method by which Yuan Huzhi set fire with the wind belongs to the same line of technique as the fire-arrows and the ramming of mengchong in the fleets of the Sui and the Tang. The reverse of the lesson was about divided command and mutual distrust: Yixuan refused Zang Zhi's plan of a two-pronged pincer, so that his forces could never be used together, and when the collapse came each wing scattered on its own. It showed that once an upstream princely command was cut off from the centre, defeat would come faster than in any pitched battle. The historians' verdict is also fixed in the record: after this war the relation between the military commands of the south and the central government never returned to what it had been before the end of the Yuanjia years.
result: 結果是朝廷全勝，叛軍全敗。孝建元年五月二十一日梁山洲決戰，臧質的水軍被王玄謨與垣護之攻破，舟船大半焚毀，義宣乘船西走，數百舸隨行而終至散盡；五月之後江陵尚餘一萬多名士兵，因義宣迷惘不出、眾無所統而自行潰散，魯秀北逃，竺超民留守江陵。最後義宣與八子劉慆及五名愛妾被押入獄戶處，六月庚寅朱脩之抵江陵，未待劉義恭與八座下書，便將義宣、其諸子與同黨盡數誅殺，義宣時年四十。豫州方向的魯爽在酒後自行稱帝，兵敗被殺，兗州徐遺寶所部亦潰散，前後呼應的三路起兵只剩荊州一路，規模雖大卻因缺乏統一指揮而全軍瓦解。荊州秩序隨即恢復，朱脩之接任荊州刺史，朝廷的江防重新連成一片，淮南與江南之間的漕運恢復正常。回頭看卡面那件埃及月牙劍，可以確定的只有一句：它與此役無涉，公元五世紀的中國軍隊用的是環首刀、長槍、弩弓與火舟，與那柄早於此役近兩千年的埃及青銅短刃分屬兩個毫無交集的技術系統，此役的勝負取決於水寨的部署、糧秣的航線與指揮的統一。
resultEn: The result was a complete victory for the court and a complete defeat for the rebels. On the twenty-first day of the fifth month of the first year of Xiaojian the water forces of Zang Zhi were broken at Liangshan Island by Wang Xuanmo and Yuan Huzhi, most of the shipping burned, and Yixuan fled west with several hundred barges that scattered before they had gone far. After the fifth month more than ten thousand men were still in Jiangling, but because Yixuan was dazed and would not appear, the command had no one to follow, the survivors melted away, Lu Xiu fled north and Zhu Chaomin stayed to hold Jiangling. At last Yixuan and his eighth son Liu Tang and five concubines were put in the prison quarter, and on the gengyin day of the sixth month Zhu Xiuzhi reached Jiangling and, before the letter of the Grand Marshal Liu Yigong and the Eight Excellencies ordering his death had arrived, put Yixuan, his sons and his party to the sword. Yixuan was forty. In Yu province Lu Shuang had proclaimed himself emperor after his drinking bout and was killed when his troops lost; the force of Xu Yibao in Yan province broke up in turn, so that of the three risings that were to have gone off together only the one in Jingzhou survived, and it was large yet came to nothing because it had no single command. Order in Jingzhou was restored at once, Zhu Xiuzhi took over as governor, the court's line on the river was joined up again, and the transport of grain between the north of the Huai and the south of the Yangzi returned to its normal course. Looking back at the Egyptian khopesh on the card, only one thing can be said with certainty: it had nothing to do with this war. The fifth-century Chinese armies used the ring-pommel dao, the lance, the crossbow and the fire-ship, and that short Egyptian bronze blade of nearly two thousand years earlier belonged to a technical system with which they had no contact at all. What decided this war was the disposition of the water stockades, the course of the grain route and the unity of command.
